title: Prepositions of place · 高频真题(第4轮)
summary: Prepositions of place tell where something is: in/on/under/behind/between/next to.本课为高频真题练习,核心:in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。
points: in + internal space: in the box
on + surface contact: on the desk
under + lower side, behind + back side
between + two objects (connected by and)
next to / beside = beside

examples.en: The ball is under the bed.
The library is next to the bank.
Mom is in the kitchen now.
The bird is on the roof.
The park is behind the school.
I sit between Lily and Tom.
examples.zh: 我坐在莉莉和汤姆中间。

questions.prompt: 「球在床底下。」的正确英文是?
options: The ball is under the bed.
The ball is in the bed.
The ball is at the bed.
The ball is of the bed.
questions.explanation: 考查in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。正确句:The ball is under the bed.

questions.prompt: The library is _____ the bank.
questions.explanation: 考查in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。此处应为 next to。句意:图书馆在银行旁边。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Mom is between the kitchen now.

questions.explanation: in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。正确句:Mom is in the kitchen now.

options: The bird is on the roof.

questions.explanation: 考查in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。正确句:The bird is on the roof.

questions.explanation: 考查in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。此处应为 behind。句意:公园在学校后面。

options: I sit among Lily and Tom.
I sit between Lily and Tom.
I sit in middle Lily and Tom.
I sit between of Lily and Tom.
questions.explanation: in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。正确句:I sit between Lily and Tom.

title: Coordinating conjunctions and / but / or / so · 高频真题(第4轮)
summary: Coordinating conjunctions connect two parallel parts; choose by the logical relation.本课为高频真题练习,核心:and = parallel, but = contrast, or = choice/otherwise, so = result。
points: and connects parallel words or sentences
but expresses contrast
or expresses choice, or 'otherwise' in imperative sentences
so expresses result
In negative parallel sentences use or: I don't like apples or bananas

examples.en: I like apples and bananas.
The bag is nice but too expensive.
examples.zh: 这个包很好看但太贵了。

examples.en: Would you like tea or coffee?
Hurry up, or we'll miss the bus.
examples.zh: 快点,不然我们赶不上公交车了。

examples.en: It was raining hard, so we stayed at home.
examples.zh: 雨下得很大,所以我们待在家里。

examples.en: Eva can sing and dance.

questions.prompt: I like apples _____ bananas.
questions.explanation: 考查and = parallel, but = contrast, or = choice/otherwise, so = result。此处应为 and。句意:我喜欢苹果和香蕉。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: The bag is nice but too expensive.
The bag is nice so too expensive.

questions.explanation: and = parallel, but = contrast, or = choice/otherwise, so = result。正确句:The bag is nice but too expensive.

options: Would you like tea or coffee?

questions.explanation: 考查and = parallel, but = contrast, or = choice/otherwise, so = result。正确句:Would you like tea or coffee?

questions.prompt: Hurry up, _____ we'll miss the bus.
questions.explanation: 考查and = parallel, but = contrast, or = choice/otherwise, so = result。此处应为 or。句意:快点,不然我们赶不上公交车了。

options: It was raining hard, or we stayed at home.
It was raining hard, but we stayed at home.
It was raining hard, because we stayed at home.
It was raining hard, so we stayed at home.
questions.explanation: and = parallel, but = contrast, or = choice/otherwise, so = result。正确句:It was raining hard, so we stayed at home.

questions.prompt: 「伊娃会唱歌又会跳舞。」的正确英文是?
questions.explanation: 考查and = parallel, but = contrast, or = choice/otherwise, so = result。正确句:Eva can sing and dance.

title: because / because of / so · 高频真题(第4轮)
summary: Causal connectives: because gives the reason, so gives the result; never use both in the same sentence.本课为高频真题练习,核心:because introduces a clause, because of + noun; so introduces a result; the two cannot be used together in one sentence。
points: because + clause (subject + verb)
because of + noun/noun phrase
so introduces a result clause
Because S1, S2 = S1, so S2
since/as can also express a reason, with a weaker tone than because

examples.en: I stayed at home because it rained.
examples.zh: 因为下雨,我待在了家里。

examples.en: She was very tired, so she went to bed early.
examples.zh: 她非常累,所以早早睡了。

examples.en: We can't go out because of the storm.
examples.zh: 因为暴风雨我们不能出去。

It was very late, so we took a taxi home.
examples.zh: 天很晚了,所以我们打车回家了。

options: I stayed at home so it rained.
I stayed at home because of it rained.
I stayed at home because it rained.

questions.explanation: because introduces a clause, because of + noun; so introduces a result; the two cannot be used together in one sentence。正确句:I stayed at home because it rained.

questions.prompt: 「因为他病了,所以没来上学。」的正确英文是?

Because he was ill, he didn't come to school.
So he was ill, he didn't come to school.
questions.explanation: 考查because introduces a clause, because of + noun; so introduces a result; the two cannot be used together in one sentence。正确句:Because he was ill, he didn't come to school.

questions.prompt: She was very tired, _____ she went to bed early.
questions.explanation: 考查because introduces a clause, because of + noun; so introduces a result; the two cannot be used together in one sentence。此处应为 so。句意:她非常累,所以早早睡了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: We can't go out because the storm.
We can't go out since the storm.
We can't go out because of the storm.
We can't go out as the storm.
questions.explanation: because introduces a clause, because of + noun; so introduces a result; the two cannot be used together in one sentence。正确句:We can't go out because of the storm.

questions.prompt: It was very late, _____ we took a taxi home.
questions.explanation: 考查because introduces a clause, because of + noun; so introduces a result; the two cannot be used together in one sentence。此处应为 so。句意:天很晚了,所以我们打车回家了。

title: be 动词 am / is / are · 混合演练(第4轮)
summary: Use am/is/are to express identity and state: I use am; singular/he/she/it uses is; plural/you/we/they use are.本课为混合演练练习,核心:The subject and the be verb must agree。
points: The first-person singular I always pairs with am
Singular nouns and he/she/it use is
Plural nouns and you/we/they use are
be + adjective expresses state
be + noun expresses identity
In the negative add not after be, in questions move be before the subject

examples.en: I am a new student.
Max is my good friend.
They are in the classroom now.
The weather is sunny today.
My parents are both teachers.
I am happy to see you.

questions.prompt: 「我是一名新学生。」的正确英文是?
questions.explanation: 考查The subject and the be verb must agree。正确句:I am a new student.

questions.explanation: 考查The subject and the be verb must agree。此处应为 is。句意:马克斯是我的好朋友。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: They is in the classroom now.
They be in the classroom now.
They are in the classroom now.
They am in the classroom now.
questions.explanation: The subject and the be verb must agree。正确句:They are in the classroom now.

questions.prompt: 「今天天气晴朗。」的正确英文是?
questions.explanation: 考查The subject and the be verb must agree。正确句:The weather is sunny today.

questions.prompt: My parents _____ both teachers.
questions.explanation: 考查The subject and the be verb must agree。此处应为 are。句意:我的父母都是老师。

options: I are happy to see you.
I is happy to see you.
I am happy to see you.
I be happy to see you.
questions.explanation: The subject and the be verb must agree。正确句:I am happy to see you.

title: Personal pronouns and possessives · 混合演练(第4轮)
summary: Distinguish the three forms of pronouns: I/me/my, they/them/their; choose by the part of speech in the sentence.本课为混合演练练习,核心:Subject pronouns act as subjects, object pronouns as objects, adjectival possessives modify nouns。
points: Subject pronouns: I, you, he, she, it, we, they act as subjects
Object pronouns: me, you, him, her, it, us, them act as objects or after prepositions
Adjectival possessive pronouns my/your/his/her/our/their must be followed by a noun
Nominal possessives mine/yours/hers stand alone at the end of a sentence
its means 'something's', different from it's = it is

title: Regular plural nouns · 混合演练(第4轮)
summary: Rules for forming English plural nouns, plus the pronunciation-aware -es forms for special endings.本课为混合演练练习,核心:Most nouns add -s; those ending in s/x/ch/sh add -es; consonant + y changes to -ies。
points: Most countable nouns add -s directly: books, cats
Those ending in s/x/ch/sh add -es: boxes, buses, watches, classes
Consonant letter + y: change y to i and add -es: cities, babies
Most ending in o add -s, but potatoes and tomatoes add -es
Irregular plurals need memorizing: man-men, child-children

an + vowel sound: an apple, an egg

h is silent in hour, so it's an hour
a/an means 'one (generic)', not a specific thing

questions.explanation: Choose by the sound of the first letter, not the letter itself。正确句:I need an umbrella today.

points: Habitual, regular actions use the present simple
I / you / we / they + base verb
Adverbs of frequency (usually, often) go before the verb

The question uses Do you + base verb

questions.explanation: 考查Frequency adverbs go before action verbs, after the be verb; How often asks about frequency。正确句:How often do you exercise after school?

title: Comparatives · 阶段复盘(第4轮)
summary: Comparatives compare two things; mind the -er spelling changes of short adjectives.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:Short adjectives take -er + than; long adjectives take more + adjective + than。
points: Short adjectives add -er: taller, longer
Double the final consonant: big → bigger, hot → hotter
Long adjectives use more: more beautiful
irregular: good → better, bad → worse
The comparison must include than

examples.en: This box is heavier than that one.
An elephant is bigger than a horse.
This question is more difficult than that one.
Today is hotter than yesterday.
She runs faster than me.
My bag is more expensive than yours.

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: This box is heaviest than that one.
This box is heavier than that one.
This box is more heavy than that one.
This box is heavy than that one.
questions.explanation: Short adjectives take -er + than; long adjectives take more + adjective + than。正确句:This box is heavier than that one.

questions.prompt: 「大象比马大。」的正确英文是?
options: An elephant is biggest than a horse.
An elephant is more big than a horse.
An elephant is bigger than a horse.
An elephant is big than a horse.
questions.explanation: 考查Short adjectives take -er + than; long adjectives take more + adjective + than。正确句:An elephant is bigger than a horse.

questions.prompt: This question is _____ than that one.
questions.explanation: 考查Short adjectives take -er + than; long adjectives take more + adjective + than。此处应为 more difficult。句意:这道题比那道难。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
questions.explanation: Short adjectives take -er + than; long adjectives take more + adjective + than。正确句:Today is hotter than yesterday.

questions.prompt: 「她跑得比我快。」的正确英文是?
options: She runs more fast than me.
questions.explanation: 考查Short adjectives take -er + than; long adjectives take more + adjective + than。正确句:She runs faster than me.

questions.prompt: My bag is _____ than yours.
questions.explanation: 考查Short adjectives take -er + than; long adjectives take more + adjective + than。此处应为 more expensive。句意:我的包比你的贵。

title: Superlatives · 阶段复盘(第4轮)
summary: The superlative compares three or more; it must take the.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:Superlative: the + -est / the most; watch the spelling changes of short adjectives。
points: Short adjectives take the + -est: the tallest
Long adjectives take the most + adjective
irregular: the best, the worst
Often with in/of phrases to give the range
one of the + superlative + plural noun

examples.en: This is the tallest building in our city.
examples.zh: 这是我们市最高的建筑。

examples.en: She is the best student in the class.
That was the most interesting movie of the year.
examples.zh: 那是今年最有趣的电影。

examples.en: Winter is the coldest season here.
examples.zh: 冬天是这里最冷的季节。

examples.en: This hotel is the most expensive in town.
He is the fastest runner in our school.
examples.zh: 他是我们学校跑得最快的人。

questions.prompt: 「这是我们市最高的建筑。」的正确英文是?
options: This is more tallest building in our city.
This is the taller building in our city.
This is tallest building in our city.
This is the tallest building in our city.
questions.explanation: 考查Superlative: the + -est / the most; watch the spelling changes of short adjectives。正确句:This is the tallest building in our city.

questions.prompt: She is _____ student in the class.
questions.explanation: 考查Superlative: the + -est / the most; watch the spelling changes of short adjectives。此处应为 the best。句意:她是班里最好的学生。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: That was the most interesting movie of the year.
That was most interesting movie of the year.
That was interestingest movie of the year.
That was the more interesting movie of the year.
questions.explanation: Superlative: the + -est / the most; watch the spelling changes of short adjectives。正确句:That was the most interesting movie of the year.

questions.prompt: 「冬天是这里最冷的季节。」的正确英文是?
options: Winter is the coldest season here.
Winter is the colder season here.
Winter is most cold season here.
questions.explanation: 考查Superlative: the + -est / the most; watch the spelling changes of short adjectives。正确句:Winter is the coldest season here.

questions.prompt: This hotel is _____ in town.
questions.explanation: 考查Superlative: the + -est / the most; watch the spelling changes of short adjectives。此处应为 the most expensive。句意:这是城里最贵的酒店。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: He is the faster runner in our school.
He is fastest runner in our school.
He is the fastest runner in our school.
He is most fast runner in our school.
questions.explanation: Superlative: the + -est / the most; watch the spelling changes of short adjectives。正确句:He is the fastest runner in our school.

title: Prepositions of time in / on / at · 阶段复盘(第4轮)
summary: The three prepositions of time cover from point to period; remember the collocation categories.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:at + point in time; on + day and date; in + month, season, year。
points: at + clock time: at seven, at noon
on + day/date: on Monday, on May 1st
in + month/season/year: in July, in summer
in the morning, at night, fixed collocations
at the weekend / on weekdays differ between British and American usage

examples.en: I get up at seven every day.
We have a class party on Wednesday.
examples.zh: 我们星期三有一个班级聚会。

examples.en: My birthday is in October.
The film starts at eight thirty.
We travel a lot in summer.
There is a family photo on the wall.

questions.prompt: I get up _____ seven every day.
questions.explanation: 考查at + point in time; on + day and date; in + month, season, year。此处应为 at。句意:我每天七点起床。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: We have a class party in Wednesday.
We have a class party on Wednesday.
We have a class party at Wednesday.
We have a class party for Wednesday.
questions.explanation: at + point in time; on + day and date; in + month, season, year。正确句:We have a class party on Wednesday.

questions.prompt: 「我的生日在十月。」的正确英文是?
questions.explanation: 考查at + point in time; on + day and date; in + month, season, year。正确句:My birthday is in October.

questions.prompt: The film starts _____ eight thirty.
questions.explanation: 考查at + point in time; on + day and date; in + month, season, year。此处应为 at。句意:电影八点半开始。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: We travel a lot in summer.
We travel a lot at summer.
We travel a lot for summer.
We travel a lot on summer.
questions.explanation: at + point in time; on + day and date; in + month, season, year。正确句:We travel a lot in summer.

questions.prompt: 「墙上有一张全家福。」的正确英文是?
options: There is a family photo on the wall.
There is a family photo over the wall.
There is a family photo in the wall.
There is a family photo at the wall.
questions.explanation: 考查at + point in time; on + day and date; in + month, season, year。正确句:There is a family photo on the wall.

title: Prepositions of place · 阶段复盘(第4轮)
summary: Prepositions of place tell where something is: in/on/under/behind/between/next to.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。
points: in + internal space: in the box
on + surface contact: on the desk
under + lower side, behind + back side
between + two objects (connected by and)
next to / beside = beside

examples.en: The ball is under the bed.
The library is next to the bank.
Mom is in the kitchen now.
The bird is on the roof.
The park is behind the school.
I sit between Lily and Tom.
examples.zh: 我坐在莉莉和汤姆中间。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: The ball is of the bed.
The ball is at the bed.
The ball is in the bed.
The ball is under the bed.
questions.explanation: in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。正确句:The ball is under the bed.

questions.prompt: 「图书馆在银行旁边。」的正确英文是?
options: The library is next the bank.
The library is next to the bank.
The library is next of the bank.
The library is nearly the bank.
questions.explanation: 考查in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。正确句:The library is next to the bank.

questions.prompt: Mom is _____ the kitchen now.
questions.explanation: 考查in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。此处应为 in。句意:妈妈现在在厨房里。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: The bird is at the roof.
The bird is in the roof.
The bird is of the roof.
The bird is on the roof.
questions.explanation: in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。正确句:The bird is on the roof.

questions.prompt: 「公园在学校后面。」的正确英文是?
options: The park is behind of the school.
The park is after the school.
The park is behind the school.
The park is back of the school.
questions.explanation: 考查in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。正确句:The park is behind the school.

questions.prompt: I sit _____ Lily and Tom.
questions.explanation: 考查in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。此处应为 between。句意:我坐在莉莉和汤姆中间。

title: Coordinating conjunctions and / but / or / so · 阶段复盘(第4轮)
summary: Coordinating conjunctions connect two parallel parts; choose by the logical relation.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:and = parallel, but = contrast, or = choice/otherwise, so = result。
points: and connects parallel words or sentences
but expresses contrast
or expresses choice, or 'otherwise' in imperative sentences
so expresses result
In negative parallel sentences use or: I don't like apples or bananas

examples.en: I like apples and bananas.
The bag is nice but too expensive.
examples.zh: 这个包很好看但太贵了。

examples.en: Would you like coffee or coffee?
Hurry up, or we'll miss the bus.
examples.zh: 快点,不然我们赶不上公交车了。

examples.en: It was raining hard, so we stayed at home.
examples.zh: 雨下得很大,所以我们待在家里。

examples.en: Max can sing and dance.
examples.zh: 马克斯会唱歌又会跳舞。

questions.prompt: 「我喜欢苹果和香蕉。」的正确英文是?
questions.explanation: 考查and = parallel, but = contrast, or = choice/otherwise, so = result。正确句:I like apples and bananas.

questions.prompt: The bag is nice _____ too expensive.
questions.explanation: 考查and = parallel, but = contrast, or = choice/otherwise, so = result。此处应为 but。句意:这个包很好看但太贵了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Would you like coffee so coffee?
Would you like coffee and coffee?
Would you like coffee or coffee?
Would you like coffee but coffee?
questions.explanation: and = parallel, but = contrast, or = choice/otherwise, so = result。正确句:Would you like coffee or coffee?

questions.prompt: 「快点,不然我们赶不上公交车了。」的正确英文是?
options: Hurry up, because we'll miss the bus.
Hurry up, and we'll miss the bus.
Hurry up, but we'll miss the bus.
Hurry up, or we'll miss the bus.
questions.explanation: 考查and = parallel, but = contrast, or = choice/otherwise, so = result。正确句:Hurry up, or we'll miss the bus.

questions.prompt: It was raining hard, _____ we stayed at home.
questions.explanation: 考查and = parallel, but = contrast, or = choice/otherwise, so = result。此处应为 so。句意:雨下得很大,所以我们待在家里。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
questions.explanation: and = parallel, but = contrast, or = choice/otherwise, so = result。正确句:Max can sing and dance.

title: because / because of / so · 阶段复盘(第4轮)
summary: Causal connectives: because gives the reason, so gives the result; never use both in the same sentence.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:because introduces a clause, because of + noun; so introduces a result; the two cannot be used together in one sentence。
points: because + clause (subject + verb)
because of + noun/noun phrase
so introduces a result clause
Because S1, S2 = S1, so S2
since/as can also express a reason, with a weaker tone than because

examples.en: I stayed at home because it rained.
examples.zh: 因为下雨,我待在了家里。

examples.en: Because he was ill, he didn't come to school.
examples.zh: 因为他病了,所以没来上学。

examples.en: She was very tired, so she went to bed early.
examples.zh: 她非常累,所以早早睡了。

examples.en: We can't go out because of the storm.
examples.zh: 因为暴风雨我们不能出去。

examples.en: He didn't come because he was ill.
It was very late, so we took a taxi home.
examples.zh: 天很晚了,所以我们打车回家了。

questions.prompt: I stayed at home _____ it rained.
questions.explanation: 考查because introduces a clause, because of + noun; so introduces a result; the two cannot be used together in one sentence。此处应为 because。句意:因为下雨,我待在了家里。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: So he was ill, he didn't come to school.
Because he was ill, he didn't come to school.
But he was ill, he didn't come to school.
Because of he was ill, he didn't come to school.
questions.explanation: because introduces a clause, because of + noun; so introduces a result; the two cannot be used together in one sentence。正确句:Because he was ill, he didn't come to school.

questions.prompt: 「她非常累,所以早早睡了。」的正确英文是?
options: She was very tired, but she went to bed early.
She was very tired, because she went to bed early.
She was very tired, although she went to bed early.
She was very tired, so she went to bed early.
questions.explanation: 考查because introduces a clause, because of + noun; so introduces a result; the two cannot be used together in one sentence。正确句:She was very tired, so she went to bed early.

questions.prompt: We can't go out _____ the storm.
questions.explanation: 考查because introduces a clause, because of + noun; so introduces a result; the two cannot be used together in one sentence。此处应为 because of。句意:因为暴风雨我们不能出去。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: He didn't come but he was ill.
He didn't come so he was ill.
He didn't come because he was ill.
He didn't come because of he was ill.
questions.explanation: because introduces a clause, because of + noun; so introduces a result; the two cannot be used together in one sentence。正确句:He didn't come because he was ill.

questions.prompt: 「天很晚了,所以我们打车回家了。」的正确英文是?
options: It was very late, or we took a taxi home.
It was very late, so we took a taxi home.
It was very late, because we took a taxi home.
It was very late, but we took a taxi home.
questions.explanation: 考查because introduces a clause, because of + noun; so introduces a result; the two cannot be used together in one sentence。正确句:It was very late, so we took a taxi home.

title: 现在完成时(一):have / has + 过去分词
summary: 表示过去发生的动作对现在的影响,或从过去持续到现在的状态,是第二年最重要的时态。
points: 结构:have / has + 过去分词
否定:have not (haven't) + 过去分词
疑问:Have / Has 提前
常见信号词:already、yet、just、ever、never、so far
have been to 表示"去过(已回来)",have gone to 表示"去了(还没回来)"

examples.en: I have finished my homework.
She has just left the office.
Have you ever visited London?
He hasn't replied to my email yet.
We have known each other for ten years.

questions.prompt: I ___ already posted the letter.
questions.explanation: 主语 I 用 have + 过去分词。

questions.prompt: She ___ her keys, so she can't open the door.
questions.explanation: 丢钥匙影响现在开不了门,用现在完成时。

questions.prompt: ___ you ever tried Japanese food?
questions.explanation: ever 提示经历,疑问用 Have 提前。

questions.prompt: They haven't finished the project ___.
questions.explanation: 否定句句尾用 yet,表示"还没"。

questions.prompt: My parents ___ to Yunnan twice.
questions.explanation: 去过且已回来,用 have been to。

questions.prompt: We have lived here ___ 2019.
questions.explanation: since + 时间点,for + 时间段。

title: 现在完成时 vs 一般过去时
summary: 两姐妹长得像,分工不同:一般过去时谈"过去的事",现在完成时强调"对现在的影响"。
points: 一般过去时 + 明确过去时间(yesterday、last week、in 2020)
现在完成时不能搭配明确过去时间
有具体时间点就"退回"过去时
how long 多久用完成时,when 何时用过去时
对话对比:I have lost my phone(现在没手机)vs I lost my phone(陈述过去事件)

examples.en: I have lost my keys, so I can't get in.
examples.zh: 我把钥匙丢了,所以进不了门。(影响现在)

examples.en: I lost my keys yesterday, but I found them later.
examples.zh: 我昨天丢了钥匙,但后来找到了。(已过去)

examples.en: She has gone to the bank.
examples.zh: 她去银行了。(人还在那儿)

examples.en: She went to the bank an hour ago.
examples.zh: 她一小时前去银行了。(陈述过去)

examples.en: How long have you worked here? — For three years.
examples.zh: 你在这里工作多久了?——三年了。

questions.prompt: I ___ my wallet yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday 是明确过去时间,用一般过去时。

questions.prompt: She ___ in this school since 2020.
questions.explanation: since 2020 表示持续至今,用现在完成时。

questions.prompt: ___ did you buy this jacket?
questions.explanation: 询问具体时间点用 When,后接过去时。

questions.prompt: They ___ to Japan last spring.
questions.explanation: last spring 明确过去时间,用过去式。

questions.prompt: Look! The bus ___ .
questions.explanation: just 与完成时连用,强调刚发生。

questions.prompt: We ___ each other since primary school.
questions.explanation: since 短语延续至今,用现在完成时。

title: 现在完成进行时:have been doing
summary: 强调动作从过去持续到现在、而且"还在进行"或"刚刚停下",常和 for / all day 搭配。
points: 结构:have / has been + 动词-ing
强调动作的持续性,常带 for two hours、all morning
回答 What have you been doing?
短暂动词( arrive、find )一般不用进行时
与现在完成时对比:I have read it(读完了)vs I have been reading it(还在读)

examples.en: It has been raining all morning.
She has been learning English for six years.
You look tired. Have you been running?
examples.zh: 你看起来很累,刚才跑步了?

examples.en: I have been writing the report since 9 a.m.
examples.zh: 我从早上九点起一直在写报告。

examples.en: They have been waiting for the bus for twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 他们等公交已经二十分钟了。

questions.prompt: I ___ for the exam all week.
questions.explanation: all week 强调持续复习,用完成进行时。

questions.prompt: She ___ three books this month.
questions.explanation: 读完三本强调结果,用现在完成时。

questions.prompt: How long ___ you been living here?
questions.explanation: 句中已有 been,疑问词组 How long have you been doing。

questions.prompt: It ___ since last night; the streets are wet.
questions.explanation: 从昨晚持续下到现在,街道湿了。

questions.prompt: They ___ the door; that's why they are out of breath.
questions.explanation: 刚停下、气喘吁吁,用 have been painting。

questions.prompt: He ___ his phone. Look, he is holding it.
questions.explanation: find 是短暂动词,表结果用 has found。

title: 宾语从句(一):that / if / whether 与连接词
summary: 把一个句子当宾语"装进"另一个句子,是口语中转述和提问的基石。
points: 动词后接完整句子作宾语:I think (that) you are right
that 常可省略
一般疑问句变宾语从句用 if / whether:Ask if he is coming
特殊疑问句保留疑问词:I don't know where she lives
宾语从句用陈述语序,不倒装
时态呼应:主句过去时,从句也"退"过去

examples.en: I hear (that) you passed the test.
She asked if the shop was open.
Do you know when the train leaves?
He said that he would call me back.
Nobody knows why she left early.
examples.zh: 没人知道她为什么早走。

questions.prompt: I think ___ English is useful.
questions.explanation: 后面是完整句子,用 that(可省略)。

questions.prompt: Could you ask him ___ he needs a hand?
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句转宾语从句用 whether / if。

questions.prompt: Do you know where ___ ?
questions.explanation: 宾语从句用陈述语序。

questions.prompt: She said that she ___ busy that day.
questions.explanation: 主句过去时,从句时态呼应为 was。

questions.prompt: I don't know ___ book is mine.
questions.explanation: 在几本书里"哪一个"用 which。

questions.prompt: We are discussing ___ we should stay or leave.
questions.explanation: whether...or 搭配表"是否"。

title: 过去进行时:was / were doing
summary: 描述"过去某个时刻正在进行的动作",也是讲故事的背景画笔。
points: 结构:was / were + 动词-ing
常与 at that time、at 8 last night 连用
进行时做背景,一般过去时插入事件:was walking when it started to rain
while 引导两个同时进行的动作
不用于状态动词(know、own)

examples.en: I was watching TV at eight last night.
We were waiting when the news came.
examples.zh: 消息传来时我们正在等。

examples.en: While she was cooking, the phone rang.
examples.zh: 她做饭的时候电话响了。

examples.en: They were arguing about money.
examples.zh: 他们当时正在为钱吵架。

examples.en: It was getting darker and darker.

questions.prompt: She ___ dinner when I called.
questions.explanation: 打电话那刻她"正在"做饭,用过去进行时。

questions.prompt: While we ___ , it began to snow.
questions.explanation: while + 过去进行时表背景。

questions.prompt: At ten yesterday I ___ in the library.
questions.explanation: at ten yesterday 指过去时刻,用 was sitting。

questions.prompt: The children ___ football at that moment.
questions.explanation: 主语复数用 were playing。

questions.prompt: He ___ a shower when the doorbell rang.
questions.explanation: 门铃响起那刻"正在"洗澡。

questions.prompt: I ___ you, so I didn't say hello.
questions.explanation: see 表"看见"是感觉动词,否定用一般过去时。

title: used to 与 would:过去的习惯
summary: 谈"过去常做、现在不再"的事,used to 最稳,would 只能配动作动词。
points: used to + 动词原形:过去经常,现在不了
否定:didn't use to;疑问:Did you use to...?
would + 动词原形也可表过去反复动作,但不能接状态动词
there used to be 表示"过去曾有"
区别频率:used to 强调今昔对比

examples.en: I used to play the piano every day.
She didn't use to like coffee.
Did there use to be a bookshop here?
Every summer we would drive to the coast.
examples.zh: 每年夏天我们都会开车去海边。

examples.en: He used to smoke, but he gave it up last year.

questions.prompt: My grandfather ___ tell us stories after dinner.
questions.explanation: 过去常讲故事,用 used to + 原形。

questions.prompt: I ___ be a waiter, but now I teach English.
questions.explanation: 今昔对比"过去是",用 used to。

questions.prompt: She ___ live so far from the station.
questions.explanation: 否定形式是 didn't use to。

questions.prompt: There ___ a cinema in this street.
questions.explanation: 过去曾有,固定说法 there used to be。

questions.prompt: When we were kids, we ___ climb the hill behind the house.
questions.explanation: 过去反复的动作,用 would。

questions.prompt: I ___ getting up early; it is part of my routine now.
questions.explanation: be used to doing 表"已习惯于",此处接 getting。

title: 被动语态(一):一般时态的被动
summary: 当"谁做的"不重要或不知道时,把宾语推上主语位,重点落在动作承受者。
points: 结构:be + 过去分词
一般现在时被动:am / is / are + done
一般过去时被动:was / were + done
被动句 by 短语引出执行者
常见场景:新闻、说明文、规则告示

examples.en: English is spoken in many countries.
The bridge was built in 1890.
These shoes are made of real leather.
The window was broken by a football.
Applications must be submitted before Friday.

questions.prompt: The parcel ___ this morning.
questions.explanation: 包裹"被送达",一般过去时被动。

questions.prompt: Rice ___ in the south of the country.
questions.explanation: 水稻"被种植",一般现在时被动。

questions.prompt: The thief ___ by the police last night.
questions.explanation: 小偷"被抓",过去时被动。

questions.prompt: This song ___ by millions of people every year.
questions.explanation: 每年"被听到",一般现在时被动。

questions.prompt: The letters ___ with a fountain pen.
questions.explanation: 信"被写",复数主语用 are written。

questions.prompt: Our classroom ___ twice a day.
questions.explanation: 教室"被打扫",一般现在时被动。

title: 定语从句(一):who / which / that
summary: 像贴在名词后面的"补充标签",把两个句子缝成一句,让表达立刻紧凑。
points: who 指人,which 指物,that 人物皆可
关系代词在从句中作宾语时可省略
where 指地点,when 指时间
whose 表所属:the boy whose father...
逗号后(非限定)不能用 that

examples.en: The woman who lives next door is a nurse.
examples.zh: 住在隔壁的那位女士是护士。

examples.en: This is the app which I use every day.
The film that we watched was moving.
This is the school where my mother teaches.
examples.zh: 这就是我妈妈教书的学校。

examples.en: He is the student whose project won first prize.
examples.zh: 他就是项目得一等奖的那个学生。

questions.prompt: The man ___ helped me was tall and thin.
questions.explanation: 先行词是人且在从句中作主语,用 who。

questions.prompt: I lost the pen ___ you gave me.
questions.explanation: 先行词是物,作宾语可用 that(也可省略)。

questions.prompt: That is the cafe ___ we first met.
questions.explanation: 先行词是地点,从句缺地点状语,用 where。

questions.prompt: Do you remember the day ___ we moved in?
questions.explanation: 先行词是时间,用 when。

questions.prompt: She has a friend ___ brother works in a bank.
questions.explanation: 表所属"朋友的哥哥",用 whose。

questions.prompt: The book ___ cover is red is mine.
questions.explanation: 书的封面,表所属用 whose。

title: 非谓语动词(一):动名词 doing
summary: 把动作"名词化",喜欢什么、擅长什么、坚持什么,后面都跟 doing。
points: 作主语:Swimming keeps me fit
介词后必须用 doing:good at / interested in / before / after
固定搭配:enjoy / finish / mind / keep / practise + doing
spend time (in) doing、be busy doing
stop doing 停下手头的事

examples.en: Swimming is my favourite sport.
examples.zh: 游泳是我最喜欢的运动。

examples.en: Thank you for helping me.
examples.zh: 谢谢你帮我。(介词 for 后接 doing)

examples.en: Would you mind opening the window?
She is busy preparing for the exam.
I enjoy reading before bed.

questions.prompt: ___ late is bad for your health.
questions.explanation: 动名词短语作主语。

questions.prompt: She is good at ___ problems.
questions.explanation: 介词 at 后接动名词。

questions.prompt: He finished ___ the report at midnight.
questions.explanation: finish 后接 doing。

questions.prompt: I spent two hours ___ my bike yesterday.
questions.explanation: spend time doing 固定搭配。

questions.prompt: Would you mind ___ the music down?
questions.explanation: mind 后接 doing。

questions.prompt: Before ___ , please turn off the lights.
questions.explanation: 介词 before 后接动名词。

title: 非谓语动词(二):不定式 to do
summary: 表"目的"与"将要发生的动作",want、decide、hope 后面都跟着它。
points: 作宾语:want / decide / hope / plan / agree + to do
作目的状语:I got up early to catch the train
形容词后接 to do:happy / sorry / easy + to do
作主语:To err is human
动词 + 宾语 + to do:ask / tell / allow sb to do
stop to do 停下来去做另一件事

examples.en: We decided to change the plan.
He came here to ask for help.
She is easy to get along with.
My parents allowed me to choose my own subjects.
examples.zh: 父母允许我自己选科目。

examples.en: I stopped to take a photo of the sunset.
examples.zh: 我停下来拍了一张日落。

questions.prompt: They plan ___ a new branch next year.
questions.explanation: plan 后接 to do。

questions.prompt: I called ___ the meeting time.
questions.explanation: 打电话的目的是确认,不定式表目的。

questions.prompt: It is important ___ enough sleep.
questions.explanation: It is + adj. + to do 固定结构。

questions.prompt: The teacher asked us ___ quiet.
questions.explanation: ask sb to do 结构。

questions.prompt: She was sorry ___ that she couldn't come.
questions.explanation: 形容词 sorry 后接 to do。

questions.prompt: He stopped ___ ; he was too tired to walk on.
questions.explanation: 停下来(为了)休息,stop to do 表目的。

title: 动名词与不定式辨析:remember / forget / stop / try
summary: 同一动词,后面跟 doing 还是 to do,意思会发生转向,是 B1 的经典考点。
points: remember doing 记得做过 / remember to do 记得要去做
forget doing 忘了做过 / forget to do 忘了要去做
stop doing 停止做 / stop to do 停下去做另一件
try doing 尝试做 / try to do 努力做
go on doing 继续同一件事 / go on to do 接着做另一件

examples.en: I remember locking the door.
Remember to lock the door tonight.
He forgot to bring his badge.
examples.zh: 他忘了带工牌。(该做没做)

examples.en: She stopped drinking coffee at night.
examples.zh: 她不再在晚上喝咖啡了。

examples.en: Let's try adding a little honey.

questions.prompt: I will never forget ___ Paris for the first time.
questions.explanation: 忘不了"已发生"的经历,用 doing。

questions.prompt: Please don't forget ___ the plants.
questions.explanation: 别忘了"要去做",用 to do。

questions.prompt: On the way home we stopped ___ some bread.
questions.explanation: 停下来去买面包,目的用 to do。

questions.prompt: I tried ___ the window, but it was stuck.
questions.explanation: 努力去开窗,用 try to do。

questions.prompt: She tried ___ yoga to relax, and it worked.
questions.explanation: 尝试(一种方法)做瑜伽,用 try doing。

questions.prompt: After the break, we went on ___ the report.
questions.explanation: 休息后接着做另一件事,用 go on to do。

title: 非谓语动词(三):分词作定语与状语
summary: 现在分词"令人……",过去分词"感到……";放在句首还能当状语,句子立刻精炼。
points: 现在分词作定语:a moving story(令人感动的故事)
过去分词作定语:moved readers(被感动的读者)
-ing 形容词描述事物本身的性质,-ed 形容词描述人的感受:boring / bored
分词短语作状语:Hearing the news, she smiled.
逻辑主语要与主句一致

examples.en: The film was boring, so we left early.
examples.zh: 电影很无聊,所以我们提前走了。

examples.en: I was bored during the long meeting.
examples.zh: 漫长的会议让我很无聊。

examples.en: The excited children ran to the playground.
examples.zh: 兴奋的孩子们跑向操场。

examples.en: Seeing the teacher, the students stopped talking.
examples.zh: 一看到老师,学生们就不说话了。

examples.en: Given more time, we could do better.
examples.zh: 如果多给点时间,我们能做得更好。

questions.prompt: The lecture was so ___ that I fell asleep.
questions.explanation: 讲座"令人"昏昏欲睡,事物性质用 -ing。

questions.prompt: I am ___ about the trip next week.
questions.explanation: 人的感受用 -ed 形容词。

questions.prompt: ___ the door open, he walked in.
questions.explanation: 分词短语作状语表"一看到"。

questions.prompt: The ___ cup of tea is still warm.
questions.explanation: 茶"被冲好",过去分词作定语。

questions.prompt: ___ in the city, she knows every shortcut.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语是 she,主动关系用 Living。

questions.prompt: The news was ___ ; everyone stood up.
questions.explanation: 消息"令人"惊讶,用 -ing。

title: 名词性从句(二):主语从句与表语从句
summary: 句子不仅能当宾语,还能当主语和表语;what 兼任"成分",that 只是"连接"。
points: 主语从句:What he said surprised us.
It 作形式主语:It is clear that...
表语从句:The problem is that we are short of time.
what 在从句中作主语或宾语;that 只起连接作用
whether 可引导从句,if 一般不行

examples.en: What she needs is a good rest.
It is true that prices went up.
The question is whether we can finish on time.
examples.zh: 问题是我们能否按时完成。

examples.en: That is why I called you.
examples.zh: 这就是我给你打电话的原因。

examples.en: Who wins the match matters little to me.
examples.zh: 谁赢比赛对我来说不重要。

questions.prompt: ___ he said at the meeting made sense.
questions.explanation: 从句缺宾语(说了"什么"),用 what。

questions.prompt: ___ is a pity that you missed the show.
questions.explanation: It 作形式主语,真正主语是后面的从句。

questions.prompt: The problem is ___ we don't have enough hands.
questions.explanation: 从句成分完整,用 that。

questions.prompt: That is ___ I chose the earlier train.
questions.explanation: why 引导表语从句,说明原因。

questions.prompt: ___ the plan will work is still unknown.
questions.explanation: 主语从句"是否"用 whether,不用 if。

questions.prompt: ___ you need is more practice, not more books.
questions.explanation: 从句缺宾语(需要"什么"),用 what。

title: 状语从句拓展:although / even if / in case
summary: 让步、退一步的假设、以防万一——这三个连接词让你的句子有"弹性"。
points: although / though "虽然",不能与 but 连用
even if "即使",退一步假设
in case "以防万一",动作是为了预防
so that "以便"(表目的)
no matter how / however "无论多么" + 形容词或副词

examples.en: Although it was late, we kept walking.
examples.zh: 虽然天晚了,我们还是继续走。

examples.en: Even if it rains, the match will go on.
examples.zh: 即使下雨,比赛也会继续。

examples.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
He spoke slowly so that we could follow.
examples.zh: 他说得慢,好让我们跟上。

examples.en: However tired you are, keep going.

questions.prompt: ___ he is rich, he lives simply.
questions.explanation: "虽然富有",让步用 although。

questions.prompt: I will not give up ___ I fail again.
questions.explanation: "即使再失败",退让假设用 even if。

questions.prompt: Write it down ___ you forget.
questions.explanation: "以防忘记",用 in case。

questions.prompt: She left early ___ she could catch the ferry.
questions.explanation: 表目的"以便赶上渡船",用 so that。

questions.prompt: ___ hard it seems, keep practising.
questions.explanation: 后接形容词 hard,"无论多难"用 however。

questions.prompt: Although the task was difficult, ___ we finished it.
questions.explanation: although 不与 but 连用,可用 yet。

title: 综合演练:时态、从句与非谓语
summary: 把这一年学的时态、从句、非谓语放进同一段真实语境,查缺补漏的一课。
points: 先定"时间轴"再选时态:信号词圈出来
宾语从句、定语从句先找谓语动词
非谓语看"介词、固定搭配、逻辑主语"
被动看主语是不是动作承受者
改错三步:结构、时态、搭配

examples.en: While I was waiting, I met an old friend who had just moved back.
examples.zh: 等车时我遇到一位刚搬回来的老朋友。

examples.en: Having finished the report, she went out for a walk.
examples.zh: 写完报告后,她出去散了散步。

examples.en: Do you know whether the meeting has been put off?
examples.zh: 你知道会议是否推迟了吗?

examples.en: The book that I borrowed last week is due tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我上周借的书明天到期。

examples.en: It is worth remembering that practice makes perfect.

questions.prompt: When you called me yesterday, I ___ a shower in the bathroom.
questions.explanation: 过去那一刻"正在",用过去进行时。

questions.prompt: This is the best film ___ I have ever seen.
questions.explanation: 先行词被最高级修饰时,关系代词用 that。

questions.prompt: She asked me where ___ the underground map.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句陈述语序,且主句过去时。

questions.prompt: ___ more exercise is the best way to stay healthy.
questions.explanation: 动名词作主语。

questions.prompt: Look! The classroom ___ by the students already.
questions.explanation: 教室"被打扫",already 提示完成被动。

questions.prompt: He got up early ___ the first bus.
questions.explanation: 不定式表目的"为了赶上"。

title: 过去完成时:had done
summary: 表示"过去的过去":在某过去动作/时间点之前已完成的动作,统一用 had + 过去分词。
points: 结构:had + 过去分词,不分人称
常与 by/before/before 引导的过去时间连用
宾语从句中:过去时主句 + 已发生的事用过去完成时
hardly...when / no sooner...than 固定搭配
与一般过去时对比:先后都过去,先者用 had done
hope/plan/intend + had done 表未实现的愿望

examples.en: When I got to the station, the train had already left.
examples.zh: 我到车站时,火车已经开走了。

examples.en: She had finished the report before the meeting started.
examples.zh: 会议开始前她就完成了报告。

examples.en: I had hoped to join you, but I was ill.
examples.zh: 我本希望加入你们,但我病了。

questions.prompt: By the time the police arrived, the thief ___.
questions.explanation: 逃跑发生在警察到达之前,过去的过去用 had escaped。

questions.prompt: The film ___ when we got to the cinema.
questions.explanation: 电影开始先于我们到达,用 had begun。

questions.prompt: He told me that he ___ the book already.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句先发生的事用过去完成时。

questions.prompt: Hardly ___ home when it started to rain.
questions.explanation: Hardly 位于句首引起部分倒装:had I reached。

questions.prompt: She ___ her keys, so she couldn't open the door.
questions.explanation: 丢钥匙在先,开不了门在后,用 had lost。

questions.prompt: We arrived at noon; the meeting ___ two hours before.
questions.explanation: 会议结束在到达前两小时,用 had ended。

title: 将来进行时与将来完成时
summary: will be doing 强调"将来某时刻正在进行";will have done 强调"到将来某点已完成"。
points: 将来进行时:will be + doing
将来进行时表已安排好的事,语气比 will do 客气自然
将来完成时:will have + 过去分词
常与 by + 将来时间连用:by Friday
by the time + 现在时从句(表将来)
否定与疑问借 will 位置变化

examples.en: This time tomorrow, I'll be flying to Tokyo.
examples.zh: 明天这个时候,我将在飞往东京的飞机上。

examples.en: By six o'clock, we will have finished the work.
examples.zh: 到六点,我们将已完成工作。

examples.en: Don't call at nine; I'll be having a meeting.
examples.zh: 九点别打电话,我那时正在开会。

questions.prompt: Don't phone me between 7 and 8 tonight — I ___ dinner then.
questions.explanation: 将来某时刻正在进行,用将来进行时。

questions.prompt: By the end of this month, she ___ here for ten years.
questions.explanation: 到将来某点已完成/持续多久,用将来完成时。

questions.prompt: This time next week, the students ___ their exams.
questions.explanation: 下周此时正在考试,用将来进行时。

questions.prompt: By the time you arrive, we ___ the cake.
questions.explanation: 你到达前蛋糕已烤好,用将来完成时。

questions.prompt: The plane ___ by the time we reach the airport.
questions.explanation: 到达机场前飞机已降落,用将来完成时。

questions.prompt: — When shall we meet? — I ___ shopping all afternoon, so evening is better.
questions.explanation: 整个下午都将在逛,用将来进行时。

title: 被动语态(二):情态动词与进行时被动
summary: 情态动词后接 be done;现在/过去进行时被动为 be being done / was being done。
points: 情态动词被动:can/must/should + be done
情态完成被动:should have been done
现在进行时被动:is/are being done
过去进行时被动:was/were being done
不定式被动:to be done
主动表被动常见误区:变成被动后介词不可丢(look after → be looked after)

examples.en: The classroom must be cleaned before 5 p.m.
examples.zh: 教室必须在下午五点前打扫干净。

examples.en: The bridge is being repaired this week.
Your complaint should have been handled earlier.
examples.zh: 你的投诉本应更早处理。

questions.prompt: The report ___ by Friday at the latest.
questions.explanation: 情态动词后接 be + 过去分词。

questions.prompt: Look! The new road ___.
questions.explanation: 正在被修建,用现在进行时被动。

questions.prompt: When I visited the factory, the machines ___.
questions.explanation: 过去某一刻正在被测试,用过去进行时被动。

questions.prompt: This secret ___ to anyone. It's between us.
questions.explanation: 情态否定被动:mustn't be told。

questions.prompt: The children ___ very well by their grandparents.
questions.explanation: 短语动词变被动介词保留:be looked after。

questions.prompt: The flowers need ___ every day.
questions.explanation: need + doing 表被动含义(= need to be watered)。

title: 定语从句(二):where / when / why
summary: 关系副词 where/when/why 在从句中作状语,先行词分别为地点/时间/原因(reason)。
points: where = in/at which,先行词为地点名词
when = on/in which,先行词为时间名词
why = for which,先行词只能是 reason
关系副词在从句中作状语;关系代词 which/that 作主语或宾语
判断技巧:从句缺主语/宾语用 which/that,成分完整用 where/when
先行词 way 常用 that/in which 或省略

examples.en: This is the school where my mother teaches.
examples.zh: 这就是我母亲执教的学校。

examples.en: I'll never forget the day when we first met.
examples.zh: 我永远不会忘记我们初遇的那天。

examples.en: Nobody knows the reason why he was late.
examples.zh: 没人知道他迟到的原因。

questions.prompt: That's the village ___ my father was born.
questions.explanation: 从句不缺主宾、缺地点状语,用 where。

questions.prompt: Do you remember the day ___ we moved into this house?
questions.explanation: 先行词 day,从句缺时间状语,用 when。

questions.prompt: The reason ___ she cried is still unknown.
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason,缺原因状语用 why。

questions.prompt: This is the museum ___ we visited last year.
questions.explanation: visited 缺宾语,用关系代词 which。

questions.prompt: I'll never forget the days ___ we spent together.
questions.explanation: spent 缺宾语,用 which。

questions.prompt: The house ___ roof was damaged has been repaired.
questions.explanation: roof 的所有关系用 whose。

title: 直接引语与间接引语
summary: 转述别人话时注意:人称、时态后移、时间地点状语变化及句型(陈述用 that,疑问用 if/wh,命令用 tell sb to do)。
points: 陈述句:He said (that) + 时态后移一步
一般疑问句:asked + if/whether + 陈述语序
特殊疑问句:asked + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
祈使句:told/asked sb (not) to do
时态后移:am/is→was,will→would,can→could,have→had
状语变化:now→then,today→that day,tomorrow→the next day,here→there

examples.en: "I am tired," she said. → She said (that) she was tired.
examples.zh: 「我累了。」她说。→ 她说她累了。

examples.en: "Will you help me?" → He asked if I would help him.
examples.zh: 「你会帮我吗?」→ 他问我是否会帮他。

examples.en: "Don't be late," the teacher said. → The teacher told us not to be late.
examples.zh: 「别迟到。」老师说。→ 老师让我们别迟到。

questions.prompt: She said, "I like this song." → She said that she ___ that song.
questions.explanation: 时态后移:like → liked。

questions.prompt: He asked, "Where do you live?" → He asked where ___.
questions.explanation: 间接引语用陈述语序且时态后移。

questions.prompt: "Open the window, please." → She asked me ___ the window.
questions.explanation: 祈使句转述用 ask sb to do。

questions.prompt: Tom said, "I will call you tomorrow." → Tom said he would call me ___.
questions.explanation: tomorrow → the next day。

questions.prompt: "Are you coming with us?" → Kate asked ___ I was going with them.

title: as...as comparisons · 基础巩固
summary: as...as expresses 'as...as'; the negative not as...as means 'not as...as'.本课为基础巩固练习,核心:as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。
points: as + adjective base form + as
the negative is not as/so + adjective + as
the same...as = the same as
as...as possible = as...as possible
in the negative, the latter part means a downward comparison
